price_note: Every unit_price_eur is a sample to verify before ordering, not a live shop price. The build is the reference micro from Mediocre Nerd, Build a Micro FPV Drone for $59 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4nRgEmdwtJo); some sellers only sell multipacks, so the checkout total can differ from qty times the per-piece sample.

parts.name: 1103 15000KV (no-name)
parts.note: The no-name motor from the video. 3.7 g is BetaFPV's figure for its 1103 15000KV; 50 g is a vendor's 1S full-throttle thrust on a Gemfan 1635-4 (40 mm). No efficiency is published; 2.0 g/W is an estimate for this class. The per-motor price is a sample, the AliExpress listing price was not retrievable.

parts.name: Gemfan 2020 51 mm 4-blade
parts.note: 0.93 g and 4 blades on a 1.5 mm shaft per BetaFPV; 2.50 USD per set of four. The pitch is listed as 1.9 or 2.0 inch depending on the shop.

parts.name: Tattu FunFly 4S 1300mAh 100C
parts.note: 149.5 g and 73 x 35 x 28.5 mm per Tattu. The euro price is a sample from Baltic Drones, not a live price.

parts.name: Tattu R-Line 1S 550mAh 95C
parts.note: The pack named in the video. No data sheet was retrievable: mass and size are estimated from Tattu's 1S 500 mAh R-Line (14 g, 58 x 18 x 8 mm). Check before ordering.

parts.name: BetaFPV LAVA II 1S 680mAh 95C
parts.note: 16.2 g, 80 x 15 x 6.5 mm, 3.8 V LiHV, BT2.0 per the shop page. Sold as a 4-pack for 31.90 EUR; unit_price_eur is a quarter of that.

parts.name: BetaFPV Matrix 1S 5IN1 V2 AIO
parts.note: 4.13 g solder-free without antenna, 26 x 26 mm mount, 1S, 12 A Bluejay ESCs, ELRS receiver and a 400 mW video transmitter. The video uses it because the MEPS AIO 7A is sold out.

parts.name: Twiglet 2" carbon toothpick frame
parts.note: 5.3 g with a 26 x 26 mm stack mount per unmannedtechshop's Twiglet 2 listing; about 2.84 EUR each from a 4-pack. cad_frame models it in FreeCAD and replaces the mass with the carbon volume.

parts.name: Caddx Ant 1200TVL nano camera
parts.note: 2 g, 14 x 14 mm, 1.8 mm lens per FPVFaster; 16.19 USD at Flywoo.

parts.name: Toothpick canopy and battery holder (TPU)
parts.note: The canopy and battery holder linked in the video. No listing data was retrievable; 2 g and the price are estimates.

parts.name: M1.4 x 3 mm motor bolts
parts.note: 3 mm long so they stop short of the windings, as the video says. Mass and price per bolt are estimates.
